description: Plum is an employee health benefits and insurance platform for growing companies in India. It offers comprehensive group insurance (health, term life, personal accident), holistic care (telehealth, health checkups, mental health, wellness programs), and an admin and employee experience focused on fast, transparent claims and integrations with insurers and HRIS. Plum positions itself on best-in-class claims experience, paperless workflows, and benefits administration for startups through enterprises.
sub_industry: Group Health Insurance & Corporate Benefits Platform (India)

products_services.name: Employee insurance (group)
products_services.description: Group health, term life, and personal accident coverage for teams with endorsements for family members.
key_features: Coverage for parents, spouses, children, LGBTQ+ partners, and in-laws

products_services.name: Healthcare for teams
products_services.description: Programs beyond core insurance: preventive care, primary care, and crisis support.

products_services.name: Personal insurance
products_services.description: Retail health and life products for individuals.

products_services.name: Business insurance
products_services.description: Commercial lines for companies (not employee benefits).

products_services.name: Plum platform (admin & employee)
products_services.description: Software for enrolling lives, managing benefits, tracking claims, and analytics.
key_features: Employee app for benefits, tele-consults, and perks

customer_personas.name: HR / People leader
customer_personas.role: Head of People, HRBP, or People Ops
goals: Fewer claims headaches and faster resolution
pains: Poor employee experience with legacy brokers
customer_personas.typical_workflow: Benchmark plans, enroll employees, manage endorsements, track claims

customer_personas.name: Startup founder
customer_personas.role: Founder / CEO at a growing company
customer_personas.typical_workflow: Select plan, onboard team, iterate on coverage

customer_personas.name: Employee
customer_personas.typical_workflow: Use app for policy details, claims, teleconsult, perks

differentiators: Claims experience and speed (cashless and reimbursement)
Full-stack employee benefits: insurance + care + platform
Solutions tailored for startups, SMBs, and enterprises
Insurtech recognition and large customer base in India
common_misconceptions: Plum is sometimes confused with unrelated 'Plum' brands; context is Indian employee insurance.
